description: Local overrides layered on top of the org-inherited Renovate config: group non-major updates per ecosystem to stop the per-lockfile PR pileup, and automerge the safe tiers once CI is green. Major updates stay separate for manual review.

packageRules.description: Group Go non-major updates into one PR (all share go/.../services/go.mod+go.sum).
Group Python non-major updates into one PR.
Group Java/Maven non-major updates into one PR.
Group Ruby/Bundler non-major updates into one PR.
Group Node.js/npm non-major updates into one PR.
Group container base-image non-major updates into one PR.

Automerge the safe tiers (patch/minor/digest/pin) once branch checks pass. Covers security patch/minor updates too. Requires the branch-protection ruleset to allow the Renovate app to bypass required review (see PR description).
Never automerge major updates; keep them separate and flag for manual review (potential breaking changes).
